items.title: OpenSUpdater Hides in Recompiled 7zip SFX, Evading Analysts
items.content: Threat actors are recompiling open source software, specifically the 7zip self-extracting archive stub, to embed a reflective loader that evades detection. The malicious code is inserted into the ExtractArchive function of the 7zip SFX module, making it difficult for analysts to identify since they typically focus on configuration files and embedded executables rather than the decompression stub... This pulse includes 5 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: OpenSUpdater, Snackarcin.

items.title: Konni Hackers Target Ukraine With Malicious LNK Files and VelvetCake PowerShell Malware
items.content: North Korea-linked threat actors are conducting Operation Conflict Compass, targeting individuals and organizations focused on Ukraine using spear-phishing emails with malicious ZIP attachments. These contain LNK files disguised as PDFs with themes related to Russia-Ukraine peace plans, Ukrainian research, and geopolitical issues. items.title: New RemControl Android Banking Trojan Steals PINs Using AI-Built Phishing Overlays
items.content: RemControl is an Android banking trojan first observed in July 2026 that targets financial institutions across Western Europe, the Middle East, and Canada.
